title: Depth of age-normalized exercise heart-rate shortfall does not establish incremental angiographic prediction across centers
abstract: Continuous depth below 85% of age-predicted peak heart rate did not establish incremental angiographic prediction beyond a threshold flag and flexible standard measurements from Cleveland (303 records) to Hungary (261 records): added-minus-baseline Brier 0.004720, joint bootstrap95% [-0.004775,0.016095].
